candidates.title: Opaque principal authorize/deny only (not full IAM)
candidates.body: AuthZ for reserve, release, expire, and lookup is opaque-principal allow/deny only. Full IAM (SSO, OAuth UI, role admin) is out of scope for this sample product. Unauthorized callers fail with a named UnauthorizedError (or equivalent named domain error) and must not mutate stock or holds.
candidates.rationale: Cross-cutting AuthZ bound repeated across initial-reservation, add-reservation-lookup, and add-lookup-available-stock (opaque-principal allow/deny; full IAM excluded). It rarely changes and must not remain buried only in successive ChangeBriefs / out_of_scope lists.
